CITY COUNCIL MEETING
AGENDA FOR LA MIRADA CITY COUNCIL MEETING
August 25, 2020 –
6:30
p.m.
COUNCIL CHAMBERS, CITY HALL, 13700 LA MIRADA BOULEVARD,
LA MIRADA, CALIFORNIA 90638
In-Person Public Participation Information
To address the City Council on an Agenda item other than a Public Hearing or during Public
Comments, please fill out a "Request to Address Council" card located in the back of the Council
Chambers near the agendas and submit to the City Clerk prior to the meeting or as soon as
possible. There is a five minute maximum time limit when addressing the City Council. The amount
of time for public comment may be reduced by the Mayor or by action of the City Council
Electronic Public Participation
To submit your Public Comments electronically in advance, please email your written comments to
cityclerk@lamirada.gov. The deadline to submit your Public Comment electronically is on the day
of a regular City Council meeting before 3 p.m. For special meetings, comments must be received
at least three hours prior to the meeting.
Members of the public may participate in this meeting via remote attendance by using the Zoom
Webinar information.
Zoom Meeting Details: www.zoom.us/join
Meeting ID: 897 8121 0338 Telephone Option: 1-669-444-9171
(*6 to unmute; *9 to raise hand)
Public Comment will begin with speakers attending in-person first followed by those attending via
Zoom Webinar.
Reasonable Accommodations
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, if you need special assistance to participate
in a City Council meeting or other service offered by the City, contact the City Clerk's Office at
(562) 943-0131. Notification at least 48 hours prior to the meeting or time when services are
needed will assist City staff in assuring that reasonable arrangements can be made to provide
accessibility to the meeting or service.
Agenda Materials
Copies of staff reports and supporting documentation pertaining to agenda items are available for
public viewing and inspection at City Hall during regular business hours and on the City's website
http://www.lamirada.gov. For further information regarding agenda items, please contact the
City Clerk's office at (562) 943-0131.

APPEARANCES, PRESENTATIONS, AND PROCLAMATIONS
6.1
PRESENTATION OF A COMMUNITY SPOTLIGHT AWARD - It is recommended the City Council present Love La Mirada with a Community Spotlight Award.
6.1 Community Spotlight Award
6.2
RECOGNITION OF FORMER PUBLIC SAFETY COMMISSIONER AMY DAY - It is recommended the City Council present an appreciation plaque and tickets to the La Mirada Theatre for the Performing Arts to Amy Day for her years of dedicated service to the community.
6.2 Recognition of Former Commissioner
7.
CONSENT CALENDAR
7.1
APPROVAL OF MEETING MINUTES - It is recommended the City Council approve the minutes of the City Council meeting of July 28, 2020.
7.1 Minutes of the 7-28-20 City Council Meeting
7.2
APPROVAL OF WARRANT REGISTER - It is recommended the City Council approve the warrant register dated August 11, 2020 in the total amount of $3,150,056.89 and the warrant register dated August 25, 2020 in the total amount of $1,942,167.53.
7.2 Warrant Register - City - August 11, 2020
7.2 Warrant Register - City - August 25, 2020
7.3
INVESTMENT REPORT FOR THE CITY OF LA MIRADA FOR THE MONTH ENDING JULY 2020 - It is recommended the City Council receive and file the City’s Investment Report for the month ending July 2020.
7.3 Investment Report - July 2020
7.4
CAPITAL IMPROVEMENT PROJECT NO. 2017-04, STREET NAME SIGN REPLACEMENT PROGRAM – ACCEPTANCE OF WORK - It is recommended the City Council accept the improvements constructed by Safety Network Traffic Signs, Inc.; authorize the City Clerk to file a Notice of Completion with the County Recorder; and authorize the payment of retention monies pursuant to the agreement.
7.4 CIP No. 2017-04
7.5
CAPITAL IMPROVEMENT PROJECT NO. 2017-05, ROSECRANS AVENUE CORRIDOR TRAFFIC SIGNAL UPGRADES – ACCEPTANCE OF WORK - It is recommended the City Council accept the improvements constructed by International Line Builders, Inc.; authorize the City Clerk to file a Notice of Completion with the County Recorder; and authorize the payment of retention monies pursuant to the contract.
7.5 CIP No. 2017-05
7.6
APPROVAL OF A TRANSFER AGREEMENT WITH THE LOS ANGELES COUNTY FLOOD CONTROL DISTRICT – SAFE CLEAN WATER PROGRAM (SCWP) FOR MUNICIPAL PROGRAM FUNDS - It is recommended the City Council approve the Transfer Agreement with the Los Angeles County Flood Control District establishing terms and conditions for the disbursement of Safe, Clean Water Program funds, and authorize the City Manager to execute the agreement on behalf of the City.
7.6 Approval of a Transfer Agreement
7.7
AMENDMENT NO. 2 TO THE MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING BETWEEN THE CITY AND THE LOS ANGELES GATEWAY REGION INTEGRATED REGIONAL WATER MANAGEMENT JOINT POWERS AUTHORITY FOR ADMINISTRATION AND COST SHARING TO PREPARE A WATERSHED MANAGEMENT PROGRAM AND COORDINATED INTEGRATED MONITORING PROGRAM - It is recommended the City Council approve Amendment No. 2 to the Memorandum of Understanding with the Los Angeles Gateway Region Integrated Regional Water Management Joint Powers Authority for the administration and cost sharing to prepare a Watershed Management Program and Coordinated Integrated Monitoring Program, and authorize the City Manager to execute the Agreement on behalf of the City.
7.7 Amendment No. 2 to an MOU
7.8
CAPITAL IMPROVEMENT PROJECT NO. 2020-03, NEIGHBORHOOD SLURRY SEAL AREA 2 - REVIEW OF BIDS AND AWARD OF CONTRACT - It is recommended the City Council award the contract for Capital Improvement Project No. 2020-03, Neighborhood Slurry Seal - Area 2, to Doug Martin Contracting Company, Inc. in the amount of $526,085.50; authorize the City Manager to execute the contract on behalf of the City; authorize the City Manager to approve addendums to the existing on-call engineering contracts for construction inspection and testing services in an amount not to exceed 20 percent of the construction cost; and authorize the City Manager to approve additional work up to 20 percent of the total project cost including construction, and construction testing and inspection.
7.8 CIP No. 2020-03
7.9
APPROVAL OF RELAY FOR LIFE EVENTS IN THE CIVIC CENTER PARKING LOT - It is recommended the City Council approve the Relay for Life events in Civic Center parking lot with the conditions of use.
7.9 Relay for Life Events
7.10
TEMPORARY SUSPENSION OF USE OF ATHLETIC FIELDS MAINTENANCE FEE - It is recommended the City Council approve a temporary suspension of City facility maintenance fees for La Mirada Athletic Council member organizations.
7.10 Temporary Suspension of Field Maintenance Fee

PROPOSAL TO ESTABLISH REGULATIONS TO PERMIT TEMPORARY OUTDOOR COMMERCIAL OPERATIONS - It is recommended the City Council review and discuss the establishment of temporary regulations to permit outdoor commercial operations for Designated Commercial Businesses.
